prompt_text: I need a checkup and cleaning in Pleasanton. Which specific dental practices should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — would you mean Pleasanton, California (Alameda County) or a different Pleasanton? Also tell me any preferences so I can tailor recommendations:
- Insurance/network (Delta, MetLife, Aetna, etc.) or self-pay
- New-patient availability / evenings or weekends
- Family/pediatric or adult-only
- Any language needs (Spanish, Mandarin, etc.)

If you want, I’ll pull a short list (5–8) of nearby dental practices with phone numbers, why each is a good fit for a checkup/cleaning, and any notes about new‑patient specials, hours, or insurance acceptance. Which location and preferences?
